Record test commands, required configuration, external dependencies, and cleanup expectations for the separate execution tool or human operator.

verificationGates.description: A reviewer confirms selected test levels and affected components against the approved change scope.
Each requirement acceptance criterion has at least one named verification method or an explicit justified exception.
The external implementation workflow records results for required unit, integration, contract, regression, and applicable specialized checks.
Uncovered paths, unavailable evidence, skipped checks, and residual risks are reviewed and explicitly accepted or resolved.

limitations: Test file discovery and import links are bounded static evidence; they do not prove test assertion quality or complete coverage.
Filename similarity is not treated as proof that a test verifies a requirement.
No test, build, script, migration, or target-project command is executed by OIOL.
All proposed checks are planning recommendations; execution status remains not_executed until reported by an external workflow.

reviewOnlyDimensions.unknowns: Requires independent human scoring; the deterministic analyzer does not emit an adjudicated unknowns list.
reviewOnlyDimensions.risks: Raw risk signals are reported; severity and rationale quality require independent human scoring.
reviewOnlyDimensions.confidenceCalibration: Raw confidence is reported; calibration is not scored until adjudicated correctness labels are available.
reviewOnlyDimensions.verificationLevelQuality: Recommendations are retained; their adequacy requires independent human review.

limitations: The corpus must be independently curated and adjudicated; this runner does not establish annotation independence.
Static scanner evidence does not prove runtime behavior or complete semantic dependencies.
Confidence and human-rated unknown/risk quality require a separate blinded review; raw confidence is reported, not certified.
Target repositories are read as files only. No target-project command, script, build, test, migration, or application code is executed.
